<a id="schema-getdatapacketscountbydataflowresponse"></a>
### GetDataPacketsCountByDataflowResponse

Message counts for a single dataflow over the requested window, broken down by status.
Mirrors the columns of the per-dataflow Batch History tab.

Required: `dataflowId`, `workspaceId`, `totalPackets`, `default`, `inQueue`, `success`, `resync`, `error`, `reQueued`, `refetch`, `archive`

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `dataflowId` | int64 | yes | Dataflow identifier. |
| `dataflowName` | string |  | Dataflow name. |
| `workspaceId` | int64 | yes | Identifier of the workspace the dataflow belongs to. |
| `workspaceName` | string |  | Name of the workspace the dataflow belongs to. |
| `totalPackets` | int32 | yes | Total messages in the window, across every status. |
| `default` | int32 | yes | Messages sitting in Default, the initial state before a message enters the queue. Normally zero — a non-zero count means messages were persisted but never picked up. |
| `inQueue` | int32 | yes | Messages still sitting in the queue. |
| `success` | int32 | yes | Messages processed successfully. |
| `resync` | int32 | yes | Messages selected for resync. |
| `error` | int32 | yes | Messages that failed. |
| `reQueued` | int32 | yes | Messages pushed back onto the queue for reprocessing. Retained on the contract for existing consumers, but no longer surfaced as a column on the Batch History page or in the summary email — it still contributes to TotalPackets. |
| `refetch` | int32 | yes | Messages selected to be refetched from source. |
| `archive` | int32 | yes | Messages archived rather than processed. |

|---|---|---|---|

| `lastName` | string | yes | Gets or sets the user's last name; minLength 1 |
| `email` | string (email) | yes | Gets or sets the user's email address (used for login and communications); minLength 1 |
| `userName` | string | yes | Gets or sets the unique username for the account (minimum 6 characters); minLength 6 |
| `password` | string | yes | Gets or sets the user's password (minimum 6 characters); minLength 6 |
| `confirmPassword` | string | yes | Gets or sets the password confirmation (must match Password); minLength 1 |
| `phoneNumber` | string |  | Gets or sets the user's phone number (optional) |
| `activateUser` | boolean | yes | Gets or sets a value indicating whether the user account should be activated immediately upon registration |
| `autoConfirmEmail` | boolean | yes | Gets or sets a value indicating whether the user's email should be auto-confirmed (bypassing email verification) |

<a id="schema-tokenrequest"></a>
### TokenRequest

Request model for user authentication and JWT token generation

Required: `email`, `password`

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `email` | string (email) | yes | Gets or sets the user's email address for authentication; minLength 1 |
| `password` | string | yes | Gets or sets the user's password for authentication; minLength 1 |
| `origin` | string |  | Gets or sets the origin URL for the request (used for CORS and security) |

<a id="schema-tokenresponse"></a>
### TokenResponse

Response model containing JWT authentication tokens and user session information

Required: `refreshTokenExpiryTime`, `isTwoFactorEnabled`, `isPasswordExpired`

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `token` | string |  | Gets or sets the JWT access token for API authentication |
| `refreshToken` | string |  | Gets or sets the refresh token used to obtain new access tokens |
| `userImageURL` | string |  | Gets or sets the URL to the user's profile image |
| `refreshTokenExpiryTime` | string (date-time) | yes | Gets or sets the expiration date and time for the refresh token |
| `isTwoFactorEnabled` | boolean | yes | Gets or sets a value indicating whether two-factor authentication is enabled for the user |
| `isPasswordExpired` | boolean | yes | Gets or sets a value indicating whether the user's password has expired and needs to be changed |
| `verificationUri` | string |  | Gets or sets the verification URI for two-factor authentication setup |
| `preAuthToken` | string |  | Gets or sets the short-lived pre-authentication ticket issued when a password check succeeds but the login is not yet complete (two-factor code still required). This is not an access token and grants no API access. It proves only that the caller passed the password step, and must be presented back to /api/identity/token/verify2facode together with the emailed code. The real access token is issued only after that verification succeeds. |

<a id="schema-twofarequest"></a>
### TwoFARequest

Request to complete a two-factor login by presenting the emailed code together with the
pre-authentication ticket returned by the password step.

Required: `code`, `preAuthToken`

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `code` | string | yes | Gets or sets the one-time verification code delivered to the user's e-mail address.; minLength 1 |
| `preAuthToken` | string | yes | Gets or sets the short-lived pre-authentication ticket returned by the login call. This binds the two-factor step to the password step: without it, the emailed code could be brute-forced by anyone who knows the user's e-mail address.; minLength 1 |
| `email` | string |  | Gets or sets the user's e-mail address. |
